title: Optimized protocol to identify nuclear receptor ligands from mammalian cells
author: Berthier, Staels, et al.

steps.title: Prepare Luciferase Assay Solution
steps.instruction: Combine KCl (50 mM, using 2 M stock, 2.5 mL), BSA (1 mg/mL, using 100 mg stock, 1 mL), Tween‑20 (0.01 %, using 1 % stock, 1 mL) and ultra‑pure water to a final volume of 96.5 mL; adjust pH to 7.2; store at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks. Use the solution at 20–22 °C for the assay.

steps.title: Make Luciferase Inhibitor II
steps.instruction: Dissolve luciferase inhibitor II to 2 mM in DMSO, aliquot, protect from light, and store at –20 °C (stable ≤1 year).

steps.title: Prepare Charcoal‑Dextran Stripped FCS
steps.instruction: Generate CD‑FCS by following the substeps below.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a suspension of 5 % activated charcoal in 500 mL ultra‑pure water.
Centrifuge at 4,000 g for 5 min and wash the pellet three times with distilled water.
Centrifuge again at 4,000 g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Add 2.5 g dextran and 500 mL fetal calf serum (FCS); incubate 16 h at 4 °C with agitation.
Centrifuge at 4,000 g for 20 min at 22 °C.
Sterilize the supernatant by filtering twice through 0.22 µm filters.
Inactivate complement proteins by heating the filtrate at 56 °C for 45 min.
Aliquot 50 mL portions and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Culture Media
steps.instruction: Make three media: (i) Cell growth (CG) medium – DMEM with 10 % FCS, 50 mM sodium pyruvate (1×), penicillin 100 U/mL, streptomycin 100 µg/mL, 5 mL NEAA; (ii) Transfected cell seeding (TCS) medium – DMEM without phenol red, 10 % CD‑FCS, penicillin/streptomycin as above, 5 mL 2 mM glutamine; (iii) Cell treatment (CT) medium – DMEM without phenol red, 1 % CD‑FCS, penicillin/streptomycin, 5 mL 2 mM glutamine. Store each at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks. Note: phenol red blunts CAR, PXR and other nuclear‑receptor transcriptional activities.

steps.title: Prepare CD‑FCS for GFP‑CAR Assay
steps.instruction: Repeat the CD‑FCS preparation (step 3) and prepare the corresponding media as described in step 4.

steps.title: Pre‑cool Plasticware
steps.instruction: Place sterile 1 mL pipette tips and 2 mL cryo‑tubes at –20 °C for 16 h.

steps.title: Thaw Matrigel
steps.instruction: Allow Matrigel to thaw at 4 °C for 16 h.

steps.title: Aliquot Matrigel
steps.instruction: Using cooled pipette tips, dispense 1.2 mL of Matrigel into cooled 2 mL cryo‑tubes; store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Cool Pipettes and Plates
steps.instruction: Cool 5 mL pipettes and 12‑well plates at –20 °C before adding Matrigel.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % Paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Prepare 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS as detailed below; store aliquots at 4 °C for 4 weeks or –20 °C for 6 months. Handle under a chemical hood.

substeps.instruction: Warm 800 mL PBS to 60 °C and add 40 g paraformaldehyde powder.
Add 1 N NaOH dropwise until the solution becomes clear.
Cool the solution to 22 °C and bring the final volume to 1 L with PBS.
Check pH and adjust to 7.0 with 3.7 % HCl if necessary.
Sterilize by filtering through a 0.22 µm filter and aliquot.
